name: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Normal Information for Mesh Extraction
definition: A regularization method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses gradients of an estimated signed distance function (SDF) to improve rendering quality and enable surface mesh extraction, addressing the issue where photometric-only optimization leads to imprecise geometry and noisy normals.
summary: This method enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by supervising SDF gradients against monocular normals to extract high-quality surface meshes, unlike standard approaches that yield noisy geometry.
